segments.contextAfter: `animation`: A constant that indicates how the reloading is to be animated, for example, fade out or slide out from the bottom. See [`UITableView.RowAnimation`](uitableview/rowanimation.md) for descriptions of these constants. The animation constant affects the direction in which both the old and the new section rows slide. For example, if the animation constant is [`UITableView.RowAnimation.right`](uitableview/rowanimation/right.md), the old rows slide out to the right and the new cells slide in from the right.
